Schema observations from the source

  • buyer_cart_items: both buyer_id and produce_id are individually UNIQUE, so each buyer can hold only one cart item. Worth reviewing if multi-item carts are intended.
  • accountant_farm_assignments: UNIQUE on staff_id and farm_id, so each accountant and each farm appears in at most one row.
  • farmer_farm_assignments: the source calls this 1:1, but the UNIQUE is composite (farmer_id, farm_id, relationship_type), so it is drawn as one-to-many.
  • agricultural_reports.inspection_id has no UNIQUE, so it is one-to-many, not one-to-one.
  • accountant_details has no foreign key in the source; it is drawn as standalone.
  • audit_logs.actor_id / target_user_id, notifications.related_id and profiles.deleted_by are plain columns, not FKs.
  • role_permissions.role_key is part of the composite PK but has no FK.
  • harvested_crops.resubmitted_from_harvest_id is a self-reference.
